title: kbjob.py serve --kind ci --job runs exactly the one job a CI pipeline was started for and refuses a job placed elsewhere
goal: kbjob.py --url URL --key-file PATH serve --kind ci --job JB-... --once takes that job from the central queue only when its placement executor is ci and it is queued, runs it in the CI job's checkout, posts every move back and exits with the job's result (0 succeeded, 1 failed or refused); a job placed on another executor, or not queued, exits 2 naming its placement and state and stays as it was

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess,threading,http.server
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    seen=[]; out={}
    def do_POST(s):
        n=int(s.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0); H.seen.append((s.path,json.loads(s.rfile.read(n) or b"{}")))
        b=json.dumps(H.out).encode(); s.send_response(200); s.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(b))); s.end_headers(); s.wfile.write(b)
    def log_message(s,*a): pass
srv=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),H); threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
OPA=f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}"
dec=lambda **k: {"result":dict({"executor":"workstation","identity":"none","fallback":None,"fallback_after_s":0,"budget_cap_usd":None,"decided_by":"default"},**k)}
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"))
kj=lambda *x,e=None: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbjob.py",*x],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300,env=e or env)
kd=os.path.join(d,"keys")
def key(p,t):
    f=os.path.join(kd,*p.split("/")); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(f),exist_ok=True); open(f,"w").write(t); os.chmod(f,0o600); return f
a=key("corp/ops/jan.kowalski","ka-placeholder"); EXTRA=[]
sv=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--store",os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"),"serve","--bind","127.0.0.1:0","--keys",kd]+EXTRA,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
url=sv.stdout.readline().split("serving")[1].strip()
k=lambda *x: kj("--url",url,"--key-file",a,*x)
H.out=dec(executor="ci"); j1=json.loads(k("submit","check","--name","backlog-check","--no-ensure","--opa",OPA).stdout)["job"]
H.out=dec(executor="workstation"); j2=json.loads(k("submit","check","--name","tests-changed","--no-ensure","--opa",OPA).stdout)["job"]
r1=k("serve","--kind","ci","--job",j1,"--once"); r2=k("serve","--kind","ci","--job",j2,"--once")
s1=json.loads(k("status",j1).stdout)["state"]; s2=json.loads(k("status",j2).stdout)["state"]; sv.terminate()
assert r1.returncode in (0,1) and s1 in ("succeeded","failed"), (r1,s1)
assert r2.returncode==2 and "workstation" in r2.stdout+r2.stderr and s2=="queued", (r2,s2)
